title: 真实乐观并发：两次409后重读合并，仅递增最终新值一次且保留并发字段
answer:
```python
import copy
def increment(request,index,docid,stale):
    current=copy.deepcopy(stale)
    for unused in range(3):
        body=copy.deepcopy(current['_source']);body['counter']+=1
        query='?refresh=true&if_seq_no='+str(current['_seq_no'])+'&if_primary_term='+str(current['_primary_term'])
        status,value=request('PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+query,body)
        if status in (200,201):return body
        if status!=409:raise RuntimeError('unexpected optimistic update failure')
        status,current=request('GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid)
        if status!=200:raise RuntimeError('cannot refresh current concurrency token')
    raise RuntimeError('conflict retry budget exhausted')
```

原题知识说明：
它们要求文档版本与读取时一致，期间发生写入会冲突。由开发重新读取并按业务规则重试，验收并发更新，不把冲突简单忽略。

title: 真实分布式terms候选丢失：局部6胜5却漏全局10，扩shard候选恢复top1
answer:
```python
def top(request,index):
    status,value=request('POST','/'+index+'/_search',{'size':0,'aggs':{'popular':{'terms':{'field':'category','size':1,'shard_size':3,'show_term_doc_count_error':True}}}})
    if status!=200 or value.get('timed_out') or value.get('_shards',{}).get('failed'):raise RuntimeError('top bucket query incomplete')
    return value['aggregations']['popular']
```

原题知识说明：
分布式各分片先选候选桶，协调端合并可能遗漏局部低排名但全局重要的桶。检查误差提示并评估shard_size或composite分页，不能把top N当完整枚举。
